nodes.name: Interest-Rate Sensitivity Risk
nodes.description: The risk that changes in interest rates may affect the valuation, income profile, or financing conditions of portfolio holdings.

nodes.name: Credit Spread Risk
nodes.description: The risk that widening credit spreads may reduce the market value of credit-sensitive assets.

nodes.name: Foreign-Exchange Risk
nodes.description: The risk that currency movements may affect the value of investments held outside a fund's base currency.

nodes.name: Geopolitical Risk
nodes.description: The risk that political, trade, regulatory, or conflict-related developments may affect markets and portfolio holdings.
